storyboard.frame: Distinct autonomous elements enter separately, seeded by the compact Ateles swarm mark.
They self-organize into differentiated roles around one shared purpose; no element loses its identity.
Work moves through visible handoffs along declared paths in rust coordination light.
One path pauses at a bounded green checkpoint, resolves, and rejoins the moving organization before the loop resets.

start_state: The compact Ateles swarm mark sits centered in a quiet 4:3 field; its distinct nodes begin separating while retaining recognizable mark geometry.
end_state: After one bounded checkpoint resolves and coordinated work resumes, the organization contracts along its own declared paths back into the exact compact swarm mark and opening camera position.
palette: Warm paper #f7f4ee, deep ink #1c1710, rust coordination #8a3b1f and #a8552d, restrained grant green #4a6741, line #ddd3bf.
material: Tactile ceramic or powder-coated role nodes, fine tensioned coordination paths, subtle paper-ground shadows, and a single glasslike checkpoint state. Realistic material response, abstract forms only.
camera: Stable three-quarter top-down 4:3 composition with one slow measured push and gentle depth separation; no cuts, orbiting spectacle, handheld motion, or speed ramps.
art_direction: Cinematic material and camera treatment with rust coordination and restrained grant green. Abstract differentiated roles only: no insects, monkeys, spiders, robots, hives, honeycomb, or anonymous neural mesh.
negative_constraints: no insects, monkeys, spiders, robots, animals, hives, or honeycomb
no anonymous neural-network mesh or undifferentiated particle cloud
no generated text, software UI, people, faces, hands, or avatars
no central command brain or one dominant node controlling passive nodes
no decorative ambient motion without a role, handoff, or checkpoint meaning
no camera cuts, frenetic motion, or glossy science-fiction control-room styling
poster_frame: The swarm mark expanded into a legible organization: differentiated role nodes, one mission, visible handoffs, and one bounded checkpoint.
